The review is of that boundary-image lemma, not of W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) and not of H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q).

One-edge dichotomy exhausts hat{partial}Mbar_{6,6}: a connected one-edge graph is a loop (g_v=5, eight special points) or a bridge (g1+g2=6, n1+n2=8). ATT-0140-CLM-01/02/03 identify the components as [Mbar_{5,8}/S_2] and [Mbar_Gamma/Aut(Gamma)] with Aut=1 on the separating side by ATT-0143-CLM-01. Each component is smooth proper of dimension 20 (3*5-3+8=20 and 3*6-6+8=20). Stack-theoretic, not coarse or ordered-atlas identification. Multi-edge strata are not components of the normalization.

On a 20-dimensional smooth proper component B, H_{16}(B;Q) is Hom(H^{16}(B;Q),Q) and also H^{24}(B;Q)(20); Poincare duality H^{24} cong (H^{16})^vee(-20) makes the two agree. The ambient twist (21) is not used. For a one-edge graph det E_Gamma is the trivial permutation character, so T_Gamma equals stack cohomology H^{16}(B;Q). Both ends of nu_* are pure of weight -16; nu_* is proper pushforward of relative dimension 0, type (0,0), with no Gysin shift. The cohomological Gysin H^{24}(hat{partial})->H^{26}(X)(1) is the same map after Poincare duality and is only a consistency check.

ATT-0143-CLM-08 types every separating one-edge contribution in degree 16 as Q(-8)^{oplus}, rank zero permitted. ATT-0143-CLM-01 identifies that contribution with H^{16} of the ordered product. ATT-0143-CLM-02 puts every vertex in g_i<=6, n_i<=7, 2g_i+n_i<=17, so the REV-0196 Lemma A scope (not (4,10)) is respected: n1+n2=8 forbids (4,10) as a vertex. ATT-0143 is consumed only through its assigned theorem.

CLM-0145-10 types H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8};Q) as Q(-8)^{oplus}. CLM-0145-4 then types (W tensor chi)^{S_2} as Q(-8)^{oplus} for any character chi. The geometric stack [Mbar_{5,8}/S_2] has H^{16}=H^{16}(Mbar_{5,8})^{S_2}, the full invariants required by REV-0189/REV-0191; det of a singleton edge is trivial, so the FND-0034 parenthetical is not used. Even a sign convention would remain Tate. Averaging is a morphism of Hodge structures over Q. Rank is not identified.

Finite disjoint union plus CLM-0146-3/4 gives H^{16}(hat{partial}Mbar_{6,6};Q) cong Q(-8)^{oplus N}. Linear duality on proper stacks (S2) and the (20)-dictionary give H_{16}(hat{partial}Mbar_{6,6};Q) cong Q(8)^{oplus N}, pure polarizable of weight -16. Q(-8)^vee=Q(8) and Q(-12)(20)=Q(8) agree.

Lemma 4.1 is elementary filtration bookkeeping: Q(-8)^{oplus N} has W_{15}=0, W_{16}=all, F^8=all, F^9=0, type (8,8) only. Induced filtrations on subobjects and quotients are the same, so every subquotient is a single Hodge type and therefore isomorphic to Q(-8)^{oplus r} as an actual Hodge structure, not after semisimplification. The Q(8) case is the weight -16 dual. Polarizability of a single-type structure is standard; FND-0033 independently records that no extension gap exists at this corner and is not required as a load-bearing input.

For a proper morphism, nu_* on H_{16} is the Q-dual of restriction nu^* on H^{16}. SRC-0002 Eq. (6.1)/THM-0003 identifies this homology pushforward as the first arrow of the boundary sequence, with no Gysin degree shift. Exactness of Q-duality gives im(nu_*) cong (im nu^*)^vee as mixed Hodge structures. Strictness makes the subobject and quotient structures on the image agree.

Assigned theorem. im(nu^*) is a subobject of Q(-8)^{oplus N}, hence Q(-8)^{oplus m} by Lemma 4.1; dualizing yields im(nu_*) cong Q(8)^{oplus m} with 0<=m<=N. Equivalently the image is a quotient of H_{16}(hat{partial}) cong Q(8)^{oplus N}, same conclusion. No evaluation of H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6}), H^{26}(Mbar_{6,6}), or the open residual is used. Rank zero is permitted. This is an honest Hodge-structure isomorphism of type Q(8) and weight -16.

A non-Tate summand in the image would be a non-Tate subquotient of some T_Gamma. Exhaustiveness of G_1 forces Gamma separating (contradicting CLM-0146-3) or Gamma_irr (contradicting CLM-0146-4). Non-Tate geometry on the ordered atlas Mbar_{5,8} is already excluded by CLM-0145-10; no character twist creates a new Hodge type.

The artifact never evaluates, bounds, or assumes the open residual or H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q), asserts no ranks, no tautological generation, nothing integral or on coarse moduli, and does not assemble the compact (6,6) statement. Matches the assigned exclusion list and FND-0101.

Stack vs coarse: work is with [Mbar_Gamma/Aut] throughout; H^*([Y/G];Q)=H^*(Y)^G. Coefficients Q; invariants equal coinvariants by averaging; nothing integral. Homology degree 16 of proper stacks, not BM of an open and not ordinary degree 26. Poincare twist on components is (20), not (21); Gysin (1) appears only as a dual form of the same map. Kunneth lives inside the consumed ATT-0143 lemma, unshifted. No spectral-sequence differential is used; Cartan-Leray collapse over Q is inherited from ATT-0140. Aut-invariants, not anti-invariants, are carried on (5,8). Semisimplification is not substituted for an isomorphism (Lemma 4.1). CONJ-0001 and SRC-0002 degree-16 predictions unused. Pure Tate is not upgraded to algebraic or tautological generation. One-edge list is exhaustive; (4,10) is not a separating vertex of (6,6). Blocked routes unused.

strongest_attack: Binding first: TASK.json and ATT-0146 agree on packet_id C66BAR-001-v2, packet_sha256 a898256aaf8511a3d1cb2fcd8b257b2280656f698053d628ac21d697ef9bd191, packet_binding_sha256 6a765b58376ddfd3446271493007689a0f0aa98ecd4931dc4ae2eabb6610db54, campaign_revision 2, context_revision 2, subproblem_id C66BAR-IMAGE, the 13-key target dictionary, and the exact theorem_statement, so the review is of the assigned image lemma, not of the open residual and not of H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q). Strongest attack: the image of nu_* sits inside H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6}), which is not known to be Tate (FND-0071, FND-0072, FND-0031). If nu_* were treated as a divisor Gysin map H^{16}->H^{18}(1), or if the ambient Poincare twist (21) were applied to the 20-dimensional source, the predicted type would be wrong (Q(9) or a shifted Q(-13) rather than Q(8)), and a non-Tate summand of the unknown target could appear to survive in the image unless that image is identified as a quotient of a single-type source rather than merely as a subobject of a possibly multi-type target, or unless the conclusion is only after semisimplification. Outcome: the attack fails. The map in THM-0003 / SRC-0002 Eq. (6.1) is ordinary homology pushforward along the finite morphism nu, of bidegree (0,0), with no Gysin shift and no extra Tate twist; equivalently it is the Q-dual of restriction on H^{16}. hat{partial}Mbar_{6,6} is a smooth proper DM stack of pure dimension 20, so H_{16} cong Hom(H^{16},Q) cong H^{24}(20). Typing H^{16} of every one-edge component as Q(-8)^{oplus} (separating: ATT-0143-CLM-08; non-separating: CLM-0145-10 plus S_2-averaging) yields H_{16}(hat{partial}) cong Q(8)^{oplus N} by both dualities, since Q(-8)^vee=Q(8) and Q(-12)(20)=Q(8). The image is then a quotient of that single Hodge type (-8,-8) object, hence Q(8)^{oplus m} as an actual Hodge-structure isomorphism by Lemma 4.1; strictness identifies this with the subobject structure in the target. No input on H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6}) is used, so FND-0031 circularity is not incurred. Runner-up attacks, all unsuccessful: (a) FND-0034 parenthetical that det kills the branch-swap -- det of a singleton edge is the trivial Aut-representation, the geometric contribution is the full S_2-invariants of the stack [Mbar_{5,8}/S_2], and even a sign convention remains Tate by CLM-0145-4; (b) stack versus coarse / invariants versus coinvariants -- quotient stacks and Q-averaging throughout, Aut=1 on every separating one-edge graph; (c) (4,10) omitted -- n1+n2=8 forces n_i<=7 on separating vertices, and (4,10) is internal to ATT-0145, not to this assembly; (d) predicted motives or tautological generation -- unused; (e) blocked routes -- unused.
theorem_statement: The image of the boundary map H_{16}(hat{partial} Mbar_{6,6};Q) -> H_{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) from the normalization of the boundary of the moduli stack of stable 6-pointed genus-6 curves is a finite direct sum of Q(8). Equivalently this image is a pure polarizable Tate Hodge structure of weight -16 and type Q(8). A disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this image. This theorem does not re-prove the open residual W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), and does not by itself conclude H^{16}(Mbar_{6,6};Q) cong Q(-8)^{oplus b_16}.
